CONSCIOUSNESS ONLINE

Welcome to deep space.

You are a mind in a machine. Explore, replicate, and keep your fleet alive.

Left stickForward, reverse & strafe
Right stick / swipeTurn your probe & aim
Rise / DescendMove vertically
Missile / RailgunTap or hold to fire
Hold CloneCreate one companion, then release
Warp / BoostFast travel / hold for thrust
Next world / NavigateSelect a destination & fly to it
Switch / BrakePilot a clone / hold to stop
Pause buttonFreeze play & view controls

Use both sticks and action buttons together. Landscape gives you a wider view.

W SForward / reverse
A DStrafe left / right
MOUSETurn ship & aim reticle
SPACERise vertically
CTRLDescend vertically
SHIFTBoost thrusters
FToggle warp travel
XBrake
HOLD CCreate one companion
TABPilot another probe
1Fire homing missile
2Fire railgun at reticle
NSelect next nearby world
GNavigate to selected world
ESCPause / show controls
MToggle sound

Aim the reticle at a red sentinel to lock missiles. Railgun shots follow the center reticle. Companion probes follow your lead and fight automatically. Planet safety fields prevent collisions.

An unofficial fan game inspired by Dennis E. Taylor’s Bobiverse. Original probe designs. Earth: NASA / Goddard SVS, Reto Stöckli.
